<proposed_plan>
## Summary
- 兼容历史双段合同并在 Step 5C 停止。
## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `wave-thread`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- `empirical_acceptance`: `not_required`
- `empirical_acceptance_rationale`: `历史输入由回放证明。`
- `review_tier`: `Tier 1`
- `review_rationale`: `只做合同检查。`
- `runtime_review_strategy`: `不创建 formal lane。`
- `review_profile_recommendation`: `无需 profile。`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`
- 收口条件：`merge-ready / Step 5C Ready`
## Goals
- G1: 保持历史双段合同可读。
  兼容路径只读历史 JSONL。
## Non-goals
- N1: 不创建任务或 PR。
## Task Orchestration
- batch:legacy [parent-child] => target=integration/main;depends_on=none;condition=true;acceptance=A1;observation_window=2026-12-31T00:00:00Z
  - wave: 1
    - task:legacy-task => owned_surfaces=src/legacy;depends_on=none;condition=true;acceptance=A2;skill=$wave-thread-flow
## Wave Thread Contracts
- batch:legacy => mode=parent-child;target=integration/main;depends_on=none;condition=true;acceptance=A1;observation_window=2026-12-31T00:00:00Z
- task:legacy-task => owned_surfaces=src/legacy;depends_on=none;condition=true;acceptance=A2;skill=$wave-thread-flow
## Acceptance & Validation
- A1 [contract/direct] batch | scope=`batch:legacy` | phase=`pre_merge` | evidence=`skills/bin/plan_contract_check.sh` | assertions=`legacy readable; Agent default release decision card publish applicability components channel bump rule predicted version target repository policy source unknown/blocked version expectation`
- A2 [contract/direct] task | scope=`task:legacy-task` | phase=`pre_merge` | evidence=`skills/bin/wave_thread_plan_contract.py --legacy` | assertions=`legacy readable`
## Assumptions/Defaults
- Historical JSONL is read-only compatibility input：已确定。
</proposed_plan>
